naslov: AI Wars Ep. 27: OpenAI limits drain 40% faster, Google locks Gmail to MCP
opis:
OpenAI fixed a billing bug in GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, so usage limits now drain about 40% faster on Astra and 25% faster on Sol than last week. Paid subscribers get one extra limit reset, and Business users get free Fast Mode through the end of the year. Google released eight Workspace MCP servers, and from February 1, 2027, AI agents must use them to reach Gmail and Drive. The Gmail agent can only create drafts and can't send emails, and heavy Gmail, Calendar and Drive use will be billed from April 1, 2027.

naslov: sqlite3_rsync: sync SQLite databases over SSH, only changed pages | AI Tool #34
opis:
A tool from SQLite that copies or syncs a database over SSH without making a full local copy, sending only the database pages that changed.

How to try it:
1. Make sure you have SQLite 3.47.0 or newer on both machines (the tool was improved in version 3.50.0)
2. Run: sqlite3_rsync db.db user@server:/path/db.db
3. Next time, repeat the same command: only what changed is transferred

Price: free

Official link: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/26/sqlite3-rsync/

naslov: What are embeddings? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Embeddings turn text into lists of numbers that capture its meaning, so words with similar meanings get similar numbers. That's how AI search finds what you meant, not just the words you typed. Example: the University of Belgrade just finished TESLA (Text Embeddings Serbian Language Applications), a three-year project that released open models and tools for Serbian on Hugging Face and GitHub.
